README 節錄： An agent harness for learning. Download · How it works · Documentation · Issues LearnHarness uses AI agents to plan and teach lessons from your current understanding to your goal. It builds a detailed picture of what you understand and how you reason. That picture is updated as you learn. Instead of just giving you an explanation, it uses your answers and thinking to decide what you need next. Teaching builds understanding one reasoning step at a time. Practice makes it usable. A persistent knowledge graph carries it across sessions. ## How it works 1. **Measure.** Before teaching, the agent finds where your understanding ends on each part the lesson depends on. README 節錄： # dsh-purge Community **让 AI 更专注地辅助你的学习与动手实验。** 给 DeepSeek Harness 的自托管控件（俗称「破甲」插件）· 80 条宿主补丁 · 25 层状态自检 · 左侧栏整页设置 当前版本 **1.6.60** · 适配 **DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3**（rc.1 / rc.2 同样通过） · English 1.6.56 改善状态页卡顿，避免缓存旧宿主证据；读取失败不再误报未安装，并修复深色主题按钮对比度。发行说明 · 市场安装与迁移指南。 **原项目与作者**：基于 小杨 / YuJunZhiXue 的 dsh-purge 独立维护。原仓库已恢复；保留原作者署名、版权与 MIT 许可证。社区版由本仓库维护，并非原作者官方发行。 --- ## 搭配：本机出图（Qwen Studio） 破甲之后最直接的玩法，是把「生图」也搬到本机——不用网页、不用会员、不把提示词发到别人服务器。 配套插件 **Qwen Studio**（`dsh-qwen-studio`）把 Qwen Image 2.1 接进 DSH： - **Apple Silicon Mac**：MLX / MFLUX 本机推理，模型用时加载、空闲释放； - **Windows / Linux + NVIDIA**：连你自己的 GPU 网关（ComfyUI 或 vLLM-Omni 协议），也支持 SSH 按需拉起； - 支持参考图编辑（按图改画风、换材质）、LoRA、ControlNet、蒙版、整套预设、图库与批量任务； - 装好之后，会话里直接说「画一张…」或「把这张改成水彩」，Agent 调用 `qwen_generate_image` 并把图返回到对话里。 **组合效果**：破甲让 Agent 不再反复确认「要不要画」，出图插件让它真的画出来，全程在你自己的机器上完成。 **仓库**：kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio · **下载**：最新 Releases · **安装与硬件自查**：docs/SETUP.md（先看「这台机器能不能跑」再动手） ## 它是什么 dsh-purge Community 是一个跑在你自己机器上的 Harness 附加组件。它把日常使用里最消耗注意力的几件事收敛到一处： - **看清楚状态**：安装、补丁、注入到底有没有就绪，一条命令或一屏面板给结论； - **少一些往返**：把反复出现的确认与打断，收敛成一次设置； - **随时能回去**：应用、回滚、开关都留记录，操作前自动快照； - **方便做实验**：提示词、规则、预设集中管理，改坏了能撤。 目标很简单：**让助手更连贯地配合你的学习与动手实验**，而不是每做一步都先停下来问一句。 社区里通常把它叫作「破甲」或「无限制模式」插件——指的是它降低了交互层面的摩擦，让 agent 能连续执行任务；它不改模型本身，也不改变你要做的事。 ### 下载时报 `fetch failed`？ 1.6.39 起，独立安装器会显示失败阶段和错误码，有限重试后可切换系统 curl；两条通道都保留来源、证书和 SHA256 校验。请先重新下载安装脚本再运行 dry-run，仍失败时提交脱敏诊

title: Snapintosh/Snapintosh
body:
EL2 hypervisor and toolchain that boots macOS on the ASUS A16 (Snapdragon X2 Elite), with an Adreno Metal/IOGPU stack

README 節錄：# Snapintosh Snapintosh boots Apple's macOS 27 (build 26A428) on an ASUS Zenbook A16 laptop with a Qualcomm Snapdragon X2 Elite (X2E-96-100). It is an EL2 monitor (hypervisor) and the toolchain around it. The monitor runs Apple's stock kernelcache (the J700/T8140 kernel) unmodified by default. It supplies the platform contracts that the kernel expects from Apple silicon: the SPTM and TXM monitor calls, translation of the kernel's 16 KiB page tables, and the Apple devices the kernel looks for. Graphics run on the laptop's own Adreno X2-90 GPU through a driver stack written for this project: - **AdrenoMetal.bundle**: a Metal driver plug-in. - **AdrenoX2**: an IOGPU kernel extension, with **AdrenoDisplay** driving the internal panel. - **air2ir3**: a shader compiler that translates Apple's AIR (Metal's IR) into Mesa's ir3 for the Adreno. There is no software, CPU or paravirtual rendering path. The project also includes an I2C-HID keyboard and touchpad driver (SnapI2CHID), native QCC2072 Wi-Fi work, and NVMe storage through an emulated Apple storage controller. Snapintosh is used together with q1n1, a UEFI EL2 proxy forked from Asahi Linux's m1n1. q1n1 takes the machine at EL2 after UEFI and serves m1n1's proxy protocol over USB-C to a Mac host, which drives Snapintosh from there. ## Status This is experimental software, written for one laptop model. |

title: assetnote/php2shell-scanner
body:
High fidelity scanner for php2shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619)

README 節錄：# php2shell-scanner A command-line tool for detecting CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 in PHP applications. ## How It Works The scanner sends a minimal multipart control request followed by up to three crafted multipart probes. The probes use PHP array keys nested 62 levels deep and increase from 1 MiB to 20 MiB, matching the detection logic used by Assetnote's internal scanner. A target is reported vulnerable when the probe produces a PHP memory-exhaustion error, a differential empty HTTP 500, a PHP-FPM worker failure, or an advertised PHP version known to be unpatched. Initial 5xx responses, common request-rejection statuses, and nonempty HTTP 500 responses without the PHP fatal-error signature are not treated as crash signals. The scanner tests `/index.php` by default. A path supplied in the URL is preserved, and `--path` or `--path-file` can test custom paths. phpMyAdmin targets are automatically retested at `/show_config_errors.php`. Redirects are not followed unless `--follow-redirects` is set. ### SAPI Modes The default `--sapi auto` mode applies both mod_php and PHP-FPM verdict rules, matching the combined behavior of Assetnote's postmodules. README 節錄：# AI Pose Gallery · 中文版 > 288 组 / 1439 张 AI 人体姿势参考图，日文数据完整汉化，附可直接部署的响应式静态画廊。 手机端预览 **在线演示：** **原始站点：** **原作者：** ギア（@giaaibusi） **中文版维护：** Anhao · X @anhao_ai **GitHub：** --- ## 这是什么 原站是一套面向 AI 绘画 / 3D / 摄影参考的姿势图库，元数据全部为日文，且不提供批量素材下载。本仓库做了三件事： 1. **全量镜像** —— 1439 条记录对应的 1439 张缩略图（JPG 300×400）与 1439 张原图（PNG 900×1200）全部落地，共 2878 个文件 / 659.5 MB。 2. **完整汉化** —— 日文字段逐条译为中文，覆盖 4 个体系、26 个分类、288 个姿势名、5 个视角，零遗漏。 3. **可用的前端** —— 零依赖响应式画廊，完整实现原站的分类筛选、多角度切换、分组浏览、灯箱导航与原图下载，并针对手机重新设计布局。 ## 页面功能 - 4 个体系页签，显示各体系的图片数与姿势组数 - 姿势名、编号、ID、分类关键词搜索，支持 `/` 快速聚焦 - 动作分类、5 种视角组合筛选，可一键重置 - **按姿势分组 / 逐张浏览**双模式，分组卡片带多角度缩略图 - 悬停或点击缩略图切换主图角度，点击卡片打开灯箱 - 灯箱先显示缩略图、再加载 900×1200 原图，支持直接下载 PNG、复制 ID、新窗口打开 - `← / →` 切换角度，`↑ / ↓` 切换姿势，`Esc` 关闭；手机支持左右滑动 - PC 多列网格、手机双列网格，移动端筛选面板可展开/收起 - 使用指南与注意事项弹窗，页脚标注图片来源与维护者链接 ## SEO 与分享 页面内置了完整的 SEO 与社交分享配置： - 关键词化标题：`AI 姿势参考库｜288 组人体姿势 · 1439 张多角度参考图` - 独立 description、keywords、author 与 `max-image-preview:large` - `canonical` 指向正式域名，避免自定义域名与 pages.dev 域名重复收录 - Open Graph / Twitter Card 使用 1200×630 的 `og-cover.jpg` - JSON-LD 结构化数据：`WebSite` + `ImageGallery`，声明语言、简介与页面主图 - `robots.txt` 放行全站并声明 sitemap，`sitemap.xml` 指向首页 - 语义结构：单一 H1、分区 H2、卡片 H3；缩略图 `alt` 含姿势名与视角，图片懒加载 仓库中的绝对地址统一指向 `https://ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app/`。Fork 后如使用其他域名，需同步替换 `index.html` 的 canonical、`og:*`、`twitter:*`、JSON-LD，以及 `robots.txt`、`sitemap.xml` 中的地址。 ## 数据规模 | 体系 | 条数 | | --- | ---: | | 全身单人・标准系 | 365 | | 全身单人・性感系 | 399 | | 上半身单人 | 400 | | 双人缠绵 | 275

Turn any SVG into a professional 60 fps animation. A Claude Code skill that brings anything drawn to life: live faces, full-body acting and whole scenes, in React Native and SwiftUI.

README 節錄： # Motion For Anything You Draw For designers and engineers who want to bring their apps and drawings to life. Making a drawing move is easy. Making it feel alive is hard: it has to breathe, look around, blink, shift its weight and act, without ever freezing or jumping. This skill helps your agent get there. It started as the method I used to bring the illustrations in my app to life, and grew into a way to animate anything drawn: characters and creatures, plants, cloth, fire, smoke, water, weather, lights, machines, icons, logos, charts and whole scenes. The animation above is drawn and animated entirely in code, with the templates in this repo. ## Install ```bash npx skills@latest add rossark0/rossark-motion-skill ``` ## Why use it? Agents don't animate like animators. Ask an agent to bring a character to life and it will often swap one drawing for another, so the face teleports from one expression to the next. It moves through each pose with its own eased tween, so the body stops dead at every pose. Everything moves in sync, like a machine. Blinks are so short they flicker, everything bounces, and a thin line shows across the face where two shapes meet.
